# What Shippo API tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is. That run is sixteen characters, so a body is it twice over and
# half of it again — the shortest body the pattern reads, since the count is a
# floor. It is spelled in lowercase where the case does not matter and in
# uppercase where the case is what a case is about: a body is hexadecimal of
# either case, so either spelling is a body.

patterns: shippo-api-token

# The two modes Shippo issues a token for. They are one kind of string rather
# than two: the mode says which data the token reaches, nothing else about the
# format differs, and a caller redacting one redacts the other.

case:     a live token in an environment assignment
in:       SHIPPO_API_TOKEN=shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      SHIPPO_API_TOKEN=«shippo-api-token»

case:     a test token in an environment assignment
in:       SHIPPO_API_TOKEN=shippo_test_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      SHIPPO_API_TOKEN=«shippo-api-token»

case:     a token in the shippotoken authorization header the api is called with
in:       Authorization: ShippoToken shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      Authorization: ShippoToken «shippo-api-token»

case:     a token in json
in:       {"token":"shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"}
out:      {"token":"«shippo-api-token»"}

case:     a token on a command line
in:       curl -H "Authorization: ShippoToken shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567" https://api.goshippo.com/shipments/
out:      curl -H "Authorization: ShippoToken «shippo-api-token»" https://api.goshippo.com/shipments/

case:     a token in a configuration environment block
in:       "env": {"SHIPPO_API_TOKEN": "shippo_test_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"}
out:      "env": {"SHIPPO_API_TOKEN": "«shippo-api-token»"}

# The alphabet the forty characters are written in. It is hexadecimal in either
# case, so a letter past f ends a body — and where the run behind that letter is
# too short to be one, nothing is located.

case:     a body written in capitals
in:       shippo_live_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01234567
out:      «shippo-api-token»

case:     a body mixing both cases at once
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789ABCDEF01234567
out:      «shippo-api-token»

case:     a body carrying a letter past f
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefg1234567
out:      shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefg1234567

case:     a body carrying an uppercase letter past f
in:       shippo_live_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEFG1234567
out:      shippo_live_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEFG1234567

case:     a forbidden character at the first body position with a full run behind it
in:       shippo_live_g0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      shippo_live_g0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     an uppercase letter past f written against a token
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567G
out:      «shippo-api-token»G

case:     a body carrying a hyphen
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef-1234567
out:      shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef-1234567

case:     a body carrying an underscore
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef_1234567
out:      shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef_1234567

# The lengths either side of forty. The count is read as a floor rather than
# exactly, so thirty-nine characters are not a token and forty-one are one token
# to the end of its run rather than a token and a character left over. What the
# floor costs is the middle case — a token cut short of forty keeps every random
# character written in front of the cut, and none of them is redacted.

case:     a body of forty characters is a token
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «shippo-api-token»

case:     a body of thirty-nine characters is not
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456
out:      shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456

case:     an alphabet run longer than the floor is a token to the end of it
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef012345670
out:      «shippo-api-token»

# The modes are read by the names Shippo writes. A mode no Shippo page states is
# no prefix, and neither is the vendor's own name written in front of any other
# word — which is what keeps the account id Shippo's own carrier-account
# response carries out of a span, and the placeholder its authentication example
# writes where a token goes.

case:     a mode no shippo page writes
in:       shippo_prod_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      shippo_prod_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a carrier account id written with the vendor name
in:       {"account_id":"shippo_ups_account"}
out:      {"account_id":"shippo_ups_account"}

case:     the placeholder the documentation writes where a token goes
in:       Authorization: ShippoToken shippo_test_token
out:      Authorization: ShippoToken shippo_test_token

case:     the prefix in a case neither all lowercase nor all uppercase
in:       Shippo_Live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      Shippo_Live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a mode written in capitals
in:       shippo_LIVE_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      shippo_LIVE_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

# What a token may be written against. There is no boundary on either side of
# the prefix, so a token keeps its span whatever word character it abuts — and
# where the run of its alphabet carries on past the floor, what carries it on is
# redacted with the token. A letter past f, a hyphen and an underscore end the
# run instead.

case:     a token after an underscore
in:       SHIPPO_API_TOKEN_shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      SHIPPO_API_TOKEN_«shippo-api-token»

case:     a token after a letter
in:       xshippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      x«shippo-api-token»

case:     a token after a digit
in:       9shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      9«shippo-api-token»

case:     a token after a hyphenated word
in:       build-shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      build-«shippo-api-token»

case:     a token immediately against japanese on both sides
in:       トークンはshippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567です
out:      トークンは«shippo-api-token»です

case:     a hexadecimal word written against a token
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567deadbeef
out:      «shippo-api-token»

case:     a word past f written against a token
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567suffix
out:      «shippo-api-token»suffix

case:     an underscored word written against a token
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567_suffix
out:      «shippo-api-token»_suffix

case:     a token at the end of a sentence
in:       the token is shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567.
out:      the token is «shippo-api-token».

# Two tokens written together. Nothing the opening is written with is
# hexadecimal, so no token can begin inside another: written with nothing
# between them the first body ends at the s of the second prefix, and the two
# spans meet rather than overlapping. Written with a space between them the two
# are separate values, and both go.

case:     two tokens with nothing between them
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567shippo_test_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «shippo-api-token»«shippo-api-token»

case:     the two modes separated by a space
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 shippo_test_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01234567
out:      «shippo-api-token» «shippo-api-token»

# What this pattern redacts that nobody issued. A SHA-1 is forty hexadecimal
# characters, which is a body exactly, so a prefix and a digest behind it is a
# token's format exactly and nothing in the text tells the two apart — sparing
# it would spare a real token written the same way. A longer digest goes whole
# rather than being cut at the fortieth character, because the count is a floor
# and the span reaches the end of the run.
#
# What holds either side of that is the floor and the prefix: an MD5 is eight
# characters short of a body, and a digest with nothing in front of it opens no
# candidate at all. The last of those is also what the tokens Shippo issued
# before this format would have cost — no page states their shape, so a pattern
# reading them would have a bare run to key on and nothing else.

case:     a sha256 behind the prefix, redacted to the end of the run
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      «shippo-api-token»

case:     an uppercase sha1 behind the prefix in a cache key
in:       key: shippo_test_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01234567
out:      key: «shippo-api-token»

case:     an md5 behind the prefix, eight characters short of a body
in:       shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shippo_live_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a sha1 with no prefix in front of it
in:       0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

# The prefix written in a case Shippo does not issue tokens in, the two
# underscores written as the hyphens a delimiter is elsewhere, and the prefix
# with either of them left out.

case:     an uppercase prefix
in:       SHIPPO_LIVE_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      SHIPPO_LIVE_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     hyphens where the prefix carries underscores
in:       shippo-live-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      shippo-live-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     the opening without its underscore
in:       shippolive_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      shippolive_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     the mode without the underscore that closes it
in:       shippo_live0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      shippo_live0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
